nom: Clarins Cryo-Flash Instant Lift Effect & Glow Boosting Face Mask

avis.texte: By using this product I've noticed my skin is tighter, softer, & the pores on my nose seem smaller. I'm in my mid 40's & was looking for a similar product that my dermatologist recommended after I had a few micro needling treatments. The similar cream she recommended was double the price of this one, so I'm glad I didn't purchase it & gave this one a try. I'll definitely purchase this Clarins cream again because it's awesome!
Pretty pricey. It did make my skin look nicer. I've only used it twice so I can't make a decision

avis.titre: It's a staple in my skincare and self care
avis.texte: I have combination skin that's fairly non-reactive. I saw this product was highly recommended and was intrigued by a cooling mask. I now use it every single morning as part of my morning skincare routine. I cleanse my face with micellar water then apply this mask. I leave it on for at least 10 minutes, sometimes longer. Once washed, my face is flushed but the redness fades after a few minutes. My skin is left soft, supple, and clear. In the morning I follow with the rest of my skincare routine, including my daily moisturizer. Sometimes I use this mid-day or as a treat. I've had no breakouts or reactions to it, and am already on my third bottle. This stuff is great, I have had a great experience with it. I find the experience of using the cryo mask to be really calming.

I took before and after photos prior to using this mask for the first time. Visible glow and lift. At this point in time, I have used it twice a week for 2 weeks. My skin looks visibly firmer and lifted, consistently. I love this product! For reference I am 48 and my skin is starting to mature and I needed something to help with slight sagging. Bought a second one right away!
I hate that I tried this because now I can't live without it. My face looks so plump after and smooth like I just got done with a nice facial.
